high_level_description: The image depicts a stylized sword with an ornate hilt. The sword is black and stands upright against a plain white background, which emphasizes its intricate design. The blade of the sword is long and straight, tapering to a sharp point at the top. The hilt of the sword features elaborate decorative elements. At the base of the hilt, there is a complex pattern that resembles a flower or a crown, with multiple layers of petals or leaves. This central motif is surrounded by additional swirling patterns and lines, giving it a dynamic and somewhat mystical appearance.
